name: Release to internal testing

# Every push to dev ships a signed build to the Play internal testing track,
# which is the owner's daily Play Store install.
on:
  push:
    branches: [dev]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: release-internal
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  release:
    # Off until the Play upload key is active and the first release exists (repo variable PLAY_RELEASES_ENABLED).
    if: vars.PLAY_RELEASES_ENABLED == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    environment: play
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4

      - name: Signing config
        env:
          UPLOAD_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.UPLOAD_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          UPLOAD_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.UPLOAD_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          echo "$UPLOAD_KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 -d > "$RUNNER_TEMP/upload.jks"
          {
            echo "sdk.dir=$ANDROID_HOME"
            echo "RELEASE_STORE_FILE=$RUNNER_TEMP/upload.jks"
            echo "RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD=$UPLOAD_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD"
            echo "RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS=upload"
            echo "RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD=$UPLOAD_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD"
          } > local.properties

      # versionCode YYDDDNN: NN = quarter-hour of the IST day (0-95), so every build that day sorts higher.
      - name: Version
        id: version
        run: |
          n=$(( (10#$(TZ=Asia/Kolkata date +%H) * 60 + 10#$(TZ=Asia/Kolkata date +%M)) / 15 ))
          echo "build_number=$n" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Check and build
        run: ./gradlew lint test bundleRelease -PbuildNumber=${{ steps.version.outputs.build_number }}

      - name: "Guard - no INTERNET permission"
        run: |
          manifest=$(ls app/build/intermediates/merged_manifest/release/*/AndroidManifest.xml | head -1)
          test -f "$manifest" || { echo "::error::merged release manifest not found"; exit 1; }
          if grep -q 'android.permission.INTERNET' "$manifest"; then
            echo "::error::The release manifest requests INTERNET. SuperChant must stay offline."; exit 1
          fi

      - name: Release notes
        run: |
          mkdir -p whatsnew
          git log -1 --pretty=%s | cut -c1-480 > whatsnew/whatsnew-en-US

      - name: Upload to Play internal testing
        uses: r0adkll/upload-google-play@v1
        with:
          serviceAccountJsonPlainText: ${{ secrets.PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
          packageName: com.superchant
          releaseFiles: app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab
          track: internal
          status: completed
          whatsNewDirectory: whatsnew

      - name: Clean up signing material
        if: always()
        run: rm -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/upload.jks" local.properties

- The release job and promote job are gated on `if: vars.PLAY_RELEASES_ENABLED == 'true'`; the variable is currently `false`, which is why run 39264079999 was skipped. The workflow comment says "Off until the Play upload key is active and the first release exists".

1. Does the Play app com.superchant exist and does it already have any release (any track)? Google Play's API cannot create the very first release of a new app — the first AAB must be uploaded manually in Play Console. Ways to check: a local service-account JSON or Play credentials on this Mac (search sensibly, e.g. ~/Downloads, ~/.config, the repo's untracked files, `local.properties` keys — NEVER print secret contents), then call the Android Publisher API read-only (edits.insert → tracks.list → edits.delete). 4. What the owner must do on their phone to get the internal testing build: whether they're on the internal testers list, the opt-in link (Play Console → Testing → Internal testing → Testers → "Copy link"), and that the phone's Play account must be a tester.
5. Also check `scripts/play_promote.py` and `promote.yml` for anything that would fail when it runs (e.g. promoting to `alpha` when no closed testing track/testers configured) — report, don't change.
